$schema_note: Each scenario is a natural-language-ish question plus the expected underlying service/orchestrator call(s), used by test_scenarios.py as a proxy for 'would Claude pick the right tool(s) for this question'. `entrypoint` names a runner function in test_scenarios.py's RUNNERS dict that performs the real call(s) against the real services/orchestrators (DEVBRAIN_LLM_MODE=stub, real db_test). `expected_calls` are 'module.path:function_name' targets spied via monkeypatch and asserted to have been invoked at least once. `expect_error` (if set) is the DevBrainError subclass name the entrypoint must raise instead of succeeding. `requires_approval` documents DevBrain_vision.md #26's write-scenario expectation. See this file's own module docstring in test_scenarios.py for the honest limits of this proxy.
